description: Request public web data as rows when browsing it yourself is impractical. Free sample first, one-off payment by the person, no signup or subscription. Collect every required field from the person first (sources, fields, filters, geo, row_target, deadline, language, description) and generate search_keywords yourself; missing or invalid fields are returned as error.missing/error.invalid (HTTP 422) and are not clarified by the service. The service is subject to applicable law. You are responsible for using the data lawfully and must not use the service for abuse such as harassment, spam or fraud. Do not send account passwords, cookies or session tokens. Save the returned request capability privately. The person must verify their email with a one-time code before the sample is shown (ask them to give you the code); sampling starts meanwhile. Then sampling runs asynchronously and every result is emailed to them.

channel_id.description: The first successful request freezes the session channel, including no channel. Subsequent requests inherit it; this grants no discounts. When omitted, the channel bound to coupon_code (if any) is used.

coupon_code.description: Optional single code applied when the quote is prepared; more codes go in coupon_codes on create_order.

dedup_keys.description: Optional compound key of requested field names, all available in the confirmed sample. Empty means canonical whole-row deduplication.

description.description: Required: plain description of the data wanted and its purpose.

prior_request_capability.description: Optional valid capability for an accepted, positively paid prior request with the same email.

row_commitment.description: best_effort (default to propose): as many as match, up to row_target. guaranteed: row_target rows; a shortfall keeps collecting until reached or cancelled (pro-rata refund of undelivered rows).

search_keywords.description: Optional hint only: up to five short phrases (platform or site type plus data type, e.g. "app store reviews", "google maps places"; do not put a specific app, product or brand name). GetMyData generates its own search for the collection method; these only inform it.

sources.description: Public page URLs or site names. Any public website is accepted when a collection method exists; otherwise the request ends with reason_code no_capability.
